protocol.status: fixed before any new thinning results
protocol.purpose: Retrospective computational depth sensitivity of the published-count-to-QC-to-frozen-marker-gate-to-frozen-topic-score pipeline; not prospective biological validation.

cohort.raw_scope: All released pre-analysis-QC count columns in the 25 selected specimens, not pre-cell-calling droplets, FASTQ reads, or the old already-QC cache.

perturbation.law: Independent Binomial(n=count, p=retention_rate) for each nonzero raw count; zero entries stay zero; every sample and arm uses the same rate. No resampling of cells or patients.
perturbation.rng: numpy PCG64 with SeedSequence([seed, round(rate*1000000), numeric_GSM]); sorted canonical CSR positions; each rate starts from original counts, not another thinned matrix.
perturbation.zero_panel_library: Mark the score missing; do not silently replace it by the encoder score of an all-zero vector. Preserve denominators and mark affected readouts non-estimable.
perturbation.interpretation: Seeds are Monte Carlo perturbations of the same cells and donors, not independent biological replication. Count thinning is not a reconstruction of missing upstream droplets or read-level technical noise.

gate.reference: Use the saved discovery reference means and SDs without refitting, including for newly admitted cells.
gate.transform: log1p(10000 * marker counts / all-gene library size), followed by frozen per-marker z scores and lineage-marker mean, then historical argsort winner.
gate.abstention: No new margin cutoff is introduced: preserve the current forced-winner rule. Explicitly report zero detected marker genes, exact top-score ties and margin quantiles; this does not validate those labels.
gate.missing_sample_genes: Zero-fill genes absent from a released per-specimen detected-gene list into the fixed model/marker panel; save per-sample coverage.

score.projection: Normalize frozen-panel integer counts to proportions, evaluate the unchanged MLP in eval mode, use softmax(mu). No sampled latent variables and no retraining.
score.high_state_threshold: Use the existing discovery GMM midpoint unchanged; this is a descriptive historical cutoff, not a biological state truth.

populations.full_pipeline: Thinned-count QC survivors, including original QC failures newly admitted by mitochondrial-fraction noise; use thinned-data frozen-reference gates.
populations.original_qc_fixed_gate: All original QC survivors regardless of re-QC result, retaining original gates. Conditional score-only sensitivity, not the end-to-end population.
populations.qc_intersection_fixed_gate: Cells surviving both original and perturbed QC, retaining original gates. Describes survivor selection plus scoring.
populations.qc_intersection_regated: Cells surviving both original and perturbed QC, using perturbed frozen-reference gates. Contrasts with the fixed-gate intersection to expose re-gating.

qc_gate: retained/lost/gained cells and fractions per specimen and arm
lineage confusion and fibroblast gate entry/exit among common QC survivors
endpoints.patient_aggregation: Pool retained cell sums/counts across specimens of the same author-mapped patient; within-fibroblast endpoints use fibroblast-cell weights, not all-cell weights. Retain empty specimens/patients with explicit missing flags.
endpoints.outcome_contrast: Healer minus nonhealer among the same 11 DFU patients (7/4); 330 exhaustive label allocations with absolute two-sided ties included. Healthy patients excluded before allocation. Descriptive sensitivity p-values are not new discoveries or clinical validation; no cell-level inference.
endpoints.seed_summary: Report every run plus min/max across all three fixed seeds, never best-seed selection or a biological confidence interval.

interpretation_rules: Report unfavorable QC, gate, rank, magnitude and patient-contrast changes without changing rates, seeds, reference or endpoint definitions.
No pass/fail clinical margin, MCID or biological acceptance threshold is invented. Baseline tolerance is numerical reproduction only.
Agreement conditional on surviving or fixed original cells is not end-to-end robustness, annotation truth, external portability, clinical validity or biological repeatability.

Completing the computation addresses the missing whole-count-pipeline stress test only; the broader RT06 concern remains at least partially open if depth sensitivity is observed or validation is unavailable.

compute.strategy: Read one archive member in gene chunks, cache its full pre-QC CSR counts, then evaluate one specimen at a time. Never densify the cohort or retrain.

smoke.scope: Real source subset for executable-path checks only; not a full-cohort result.
